policy.rationale: Initial research operating policy: one documented daily publication interval (24 hours) plus 12 hours of publication-delay tolerance. Retrieve and normalize within one hour before T90; allow fifteen minutes after T90 for bounded generation and durable recovery. These are operational limits, not scientifically optimal thresholds or the original fresh-input T90 protocol.
